title: What is schizophrenia? - Anees Bahji
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】什麼是精神分裂症？ ——阿內斯·巴吉（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Schizophrenia was first identified more than a century ago,
cues.en: Schizophrenia was first identified more than a century ago,
cues.zh: 初次發現思覺失調症 是至少一個世紀以前的事，

cues.text: but we still don’t know its exact causes.
cues.en: but we still don’t know its exact causes.
cues.zh: 初次發現思覺失調症 是至少一個世紀以前的事， 但我們目前仍然不知道 它的確切成因。 它仍然是現今最被誤解 及汙名化的疾病之一。

cues.text: It remains one of the most misunderstood and stigmatized illnesses today.
cues.en: It remains one of the most misunderstood and stigmatized illnesses today.
cues.zh: 它仍然是現今最被誤解 及汙名化的疾病之一。

cues.text: So, let’s walk through what we do know— from symptoms to causes and treatments.
cues.en: So, let’s walk through what we do know— from symptoms to causes and treatments.
cues.zh: 那麼，咱們來談談那些已知的事實 從症狀到成因及治療。

cues.text: Schizophrenia is considered a syndrome, which means it may encompass a number of related disorders
cues.en: Schizophrenia is considered a syndrome, which means it may encompass a number of related disorders
cues.zh: 思覺失調症被認為是一種症候群， 意思就是說，它可能 包含多種相關的病徵，

cues.text: that have similar symptoms but varying causes.
cues.en: that have similar symptoms but varying causes.
cues.zh: 意思就是說，它可能 包含多種相關的病徵， 具有類似的症狀， 但各式各樣的成因。

cues.text: Every person with schizophrenia has slightly different symptoms,
cues.en: Every person with schizophrenia has slightly different symptoms,
cues.zh: 每位有思覺失調症的人 都有些微不同的症狀，

cues.text: and the first signs can be easy to miss— subtle personality changes, irritability,
cues.en: and the first signs can be easy to miss— subtle personality changes, irritability,
cues.zh: 每位有思覺失調症的人 都有些微不同的症狀， 且最初的徵兆很容易被忽視—— 人格發生些微改變、易怒，

cues.text: or a gradual encroachment of unusual thoughts.
cues.en: or a gradual encroachment of unusual thoughts.
cues.zh: 人格發生些微改變、易怒， 或漸漸被不尋常的想法給侵佔。

cues.text: Patients are usually diagnosed after the onset of psychosis,
cues.en: Patients are usually diagnosed after the onset of psychosis,
cues.zh: 病人通常是在精神病 發作之後才被診斷出來，

cues.text: which typically occurs in the late teens or early twenties for men
cues.en: which typically occurs in the late teens or early twenties for men
cues.zh: 病人通常是在精神病 發作之後才被診斷出來， 男性多半會發生在 接近二十歲或二十歲初頭時， 女性多半會發生在 接近三十歲或三十歲初頭時。

cues.text: and the late twenties or early thirties for women.
cues.en: and the late twenties or early thirties for women.
cues.zh: 女性多半會發生在 接近三十歲或三十歲初頭時。

cues.text: A first psychotic episode can feature delusions, hallucinations,
cues.en: A first psychotic episode can feature delusions, hallucinations,
cues.zh: 在第一次精神病發作時， 可能會有妄想、幻覺，

cues.text: and disordered speech and behavior.
cues.en: and disordered speech and behavior.
cues.zh: 在第一次精神病發作時， 可能會有妄想、幻覺， 以及錯亂的言行舉止。

cues.text: These are called positive symptoms, meaning they occur in people with schizophrenia
cues.en: These are called positive symptoms, meaning they occur in people with schizophrenia
cues.zh: 這些叫做正性症狀， 意即，思覺失調症患者才會有，

cues.text: but not in the general population.
cues.en: but not in the general population.
cues.zh: 一般人則不會。

cues.text: It’s a common misperception that people with schizophrenia
cues.en: It’s a common misperception that people with schizophrenia
cues.zh: 常見的錯誤觀念是， 有思覺失調症的人

cues.text: have multiple personalities, but these symptoms indicate a disruption of thought processes,
cues.en: have multiple personalities, but these symptoms indicate a disruption of thought processes,
cues.zh: 常見的錯誤觀念是， 有思覺失調症的人 就會有多重人格， 但實際上這些症狀是 思考過程被打斷的表現，

cues.text: rather than the manifestation of another personality.
cues.en: rather than the manifestation of another personality.
cues.zh: 但實際上這些症狀是 思考過程被打斷的表現， 而並非另一個人格的形成出現。

cues.text: Schizophrenia also has negative symptoms, these are qualities that are reduced in people with schizophrenia,
cues.en: Schizophrenia also has negative symptoms, these are qualities that are reduced in people with schizophrenia,
cues.zh: 思覺失調症也會出現負性症狀， 也就是有思覺失調症的人 身上會缺乏這些特性，

cues.text: such as motivation, expression of emotion, or speech.
cues.en: such as motivation, expression of emotion, or speech.
cues.zh: 也就是有思覺失調症的人 身上會缺乏這些特性， 比如動力、情緒表達，或語言能力。

cues.text: There are cognitive symptoms as well, like difficulty concentrating,
cues.en: There are cognitive symptoms as well, like difficulty concentrating,
cues.zh: 也有一些認知症狀， 比如難以集中注意力、 記住資訊，以及做決策。

cues.text: remembering information, and making decisions.
cues.en: remembering information, and making decisions.
cues.zh: 記住資訊，以及做決策。

cues.text: So what causes the onset of psychosis?
cues.en: So what causes the onset of psychosis?
cues.zh: 所以，造成精神病發作的原因是什麼？ 成因很可能不是單一的，

cues.text: There likely isn’t one single cause, but a combination of genetic and environmental risk factors that contribute.
cues.en: There likely isn’t one single cause, but a combination of genetic and environmental risk factors that contribute.
cues.zh: 成因很可能不是單一的， 而是基因與環境風險因子 結合在一起所導致。

cues.text: Schizophrenia has some of the strongest genetic links of any psychiatric illness.
cues.en: Schizophrenia has some of the strongest genetic links of any psychiatric illness.
cues.zh: 在所有的精神疾病中， 思覺失調症和基因的連結最強。

cues.text: Though about 1% of people have schizophrenia, children or siblings of people with schizophrenia are ten times likelier
cues.en: Though about 1% of people have schizophrenia, children or siblings of people with schizophrenia are ten times likelier
cues.zh: 在所有的精神疾病中， 思覺失調症和基因的連結最強。 雖然約有 1% 的人有思覺失調症， 思覺失調症患者的 孩子或手足的發病率， 可能會比其他人要高十倍。

cues.text: to develop the disease, and an identical twin of someone with schizophrenia
cues.en: to develop the disease, and an identical twin of someone with schizophrenia
cues.zh: 可能會比其他人要高十倍。 如果同卵雙生的雙胞胎中一人 有思覺失調症，

cues.text: has a 40% chance of being affected.
cues.en: has a 40% chance of being affected.
cues.zh: 如果同卵雙生的雙胞胎中一人 有思覺失調症， 另外一人則有四成的機會被影響到。

cues.text: Often, immediate relatives of people with schizophrenia exhibit milder versions of traits associated with the disorder—
cues.en: Often, immediate relatives of people with schizophrenia exhibit milder versions of traits associated with the disorder—
cues.zh: 通常，思覺失調症患者的直系親人 也會呈現出該病症的相關特質， 只是比較輕微——

cues.text: but not to an extent that requires treatment.
cues.en: but not to an extent that requires treatment.
cues.zh: 也會呈現出該病症的相關特質， 只是比較輕微—— 還沒有到需要治療的程度。

cues.text: Multiple genes almost certainly play a role, but we don’t know how many, or which ones.
cues.en: Multiple genes almost certainly play a role, but we don’t know how many, or which ones.
cues.zh: 幾乎可以確定思覺失調症 和多個基因相關， 但我們還不知道 基因的具體個數和型別。

cues.text: Environmental factors like exposure to certain viruses in early infancy
cues.en: Environmental factors like exposure to certain viruses in early infancy
cues.zh: 環境因子，如在嬰兒期 初期接觸到某些病毒，

cues.text: might increase the chance that someone will develop schizophrenia,
cues.en: might increase the chance that someone will develop schizophrenia,
cues.zh: 環境因子，如在嬰兒期 初期接觸到某些病毒， 可能會增加患思覺失調症的機會，

cues.text: and use of some drugs, including marijuana, may trigger the onset of psychosis
cues.en: and use of some drugs, including marijuana, may trigger the onset of psychosis
cues.zh: 可能會增加患思覺失調症的機會， 而服用某些藥物，包括大麻， 可能會促使易受影響者發病。

cues.text: in highly susceptible individuals.
cues.en: in highly susceptible individuals.
cues.zh: 可能會促使易受影響者發病。

cues.text: These factors don’t affect everyone the same way.
cues.en: These factors don’t affect everyone the same way.
cues.zh: 這些因子對每一個人的影響不同。

cues.text: For those with very low genetic risk, no amount of exposure to environmental risk factors
cues.en: For those with very low genetic risk, no amount of exposure to environmental risk factors
cues.zh: 對基因風險非常低的人來說， 不論暴露在多少量的 環境風險因子之下， 都不會讓他們發展出思覺失調症；

cues.text: will lead them to develop schizophrenia; for those with very high risk, moderate additional risk might tip the balance.
cues.en: will lead them to develop schizophrenia; for those with very high risk, moderate additional risk might tip the balance.
cues.zh: 都不會讓他們發展出思覺失調症； 至於風險非常高的人， 只要減少額外風險 就有可能會破壞平衡。

cues.text: The antipsychotic drugs used to treat schizophrenia have helped researchers
cues.en: The antipsychotic drugs used to treat schizophrenia have helped researchers
cues.zh: 用來治療思覺失調症的 抗精神疾病藥物能協助研究者

cues.text: work backwards to trace signatures of the disorder in the brain.
cues.en: work backwards to trace signatures of the disorder in the brain.
cues.zh: 用來治療思覺失調症的 抗精神疾病藥物能協助研究者 追蹤這種病症在大腦中的特徵。

cues.text: Traditional antipsychotics block dopamine receptors.
cues.en: Traditional antipsychotics block dopamine receptors.
cues.zh: 傳統的抗精神疾病藥物 會阻隔多巴胺受體。 對於減輕正性症狀很有效果，

cues.text: They can be very effective in reducing positive symptoms,
cues.en: They can be very effective in reducing positive symptoms,
cues.zh: 對於減輕正性症狀很有效果， 因為這些症狀和大腦中 特定通路的多巴胺含量過高有關。

cues.text: which are linked to an excess of dopamine in particular brain pathways.
cues.en: which are linked to an excess of dopamine in particular brain pathways.
cues.zh: 對於減輕正性症狀很有效果， 因為這些症狀和大腦中 特定通路的多巴胺含量過高有關。

cues.text: But the same drugs can make negative symptoms worse, and we’ve found that negative symptoms of schizophrenia may be tied
cues.en: But the same drugs can make negative symptoms worse, and we’ve found that negative symptoms of schizophrenia may be tied
cues.zh: 但，同樣的藥物也有可能 讓負性症狀更嚴重， 研究已經發現， 思覺失調症的負性症狀 可能和大腦其他區域的 多巴胺含量太低有關。

cues.text: to too little dopamine in other brain areas.
cues.en: to too little dopamine in other brain areas.
cues.zh: 可能和大腦其他區域的 多巴胺含量太低有關。 有些思覺失調症患者會出現 神經組織流失的狀況，

cues.text: Some people with schizophrenia show a loss of neural tissue, and it’s unclear whether this atrophy is a result of the disease itself
cues.en: Some people with schizophrenia show a loss of neural tissue, and it’s unclear whether this atrophy is a result of the disease itself
cues.zh: 有些思覺失調症患者會出現 神經組織流失的狀況， 我們仍不清楚這種萎縮 是該疾病本身的直接結果，

cues.text: or drug-induced suppression of signaling.
cues.en: or drug-induced suppression of signaling.
cues.zh: 我們仍不清楚這種萎縮 是該疾病本身的直接結果， 或是藥物導致訊號傳遞被壓制的結果。

cues.text: Fortunately, newer generations of antipsychotics aim to address
cues.en: Fortunately, newer generations of antipsychotics aim to address
cues.zh: 幸運的是，近幾代的抗精神病藥物 都是透過針對多種神經傳遞介質 來解決這些問題，

cues.text: some of these issues by targeting multiple neurotransmitters,
cues.en: some of these issues by targeting multiple neurotransmitters,
cues.zh: 都是透過針對多種神經傳遞介質 來解決這些問題，

cues.text: like serotonin in addition to dopamine.
cues.en: like serotonin in addition to dopamine.
cues.zh: 都是透過針對多種神經傳遞介質 來解決這些問題， 比如血清素加上多巴胺。

cues.text: It’s clear that no one transmitter system is responsible for all symptoms,
cues.en: It’s clear that no one transmitter system is responsible for all symptoms,
cues.zh: 可以確定的一點是，所有症狀 並不是單一傳遞介質系統造成，

cues.text: and because these drugs affect signaling throughout the brain and body,
cues.en: and because these drugs affect signaling throughout the brain and body,
cues.zh: 可以確定的一點是，所有症狀 並不是單一傳遞介質系統造成， 而且，因為這些藥物會影響 大腦和身體各處的訊號傳遞，

cues.text: they can have other side effects like weight gain.
cues.en: they can have other side effects like weight gain.
cues.zh: 而且，因為這些藥物會影響 大腦和身體各處的訊號傳遞， 服藥可能會引起其他 副作用，如體重增加。 儘管有併發症， 抗精神病藥物仍然非常有效，

cues.text: In spite of these complications, antipsychotics can be very effective,
cues.en: In spite of these complications, antipsychotics can be very effective,
cues.zh: 儘管有併發症， 抗精神病藥物仍然非常有效，

cues.text: especially when combined with other interventions like cognitive-behavioral therapy.
cues.en: especially when combined with other interventions like cognitive-behavioral therapy.
cues.zh: 儘管有併發症， 抗精神病藥物仍然非常有效， 特別是與其他醫療介入方式結合， 比如認知行為治療。

cues.text: Electroconvulsive therapy, though it provides relatively short-lived relief,
cues.en: Electroconvulsive therapy, though it provides relatively short-lived relief,
cues.zh: 雖然電痙攣療法僅能提供 相對短暫的舒緩，

cues.text: is also re-emerging as an effective treatment, especially when other options have failed.
cues.en: is also re-emerging as an effective treatment, especially when other options have failed.
cues.zh: 雖然電痙攣療法僅能提供 相對短暫的舒緩， 但也被再次用作有效治療方式， 特別是在其他療法都無效時。 早期介入治療也非常重要。

cues.text: Early intervention is also extremely important.
cues.en: Early intervention is also extremely important.
cues.zh: 早期介入治療也非常重要。 如果得了精神病後的 數個月或數年沒有去治療，

cues.text: After months or years of untreated psychosis, certain psychoses can become embedded in someone’s personality.
cues.en: After months or years of untreated psychosis, certain psychoses can become embedded in someone’s personality.
cues.zh: 如果得了精神病後的 數個月或數年沒有去治療， 某些精神異常可能就會 變成病人人格的一部分。 然而，由於精神病的診斷 會讓人背上沒人性的汙名，

cues.text: And yet, the dehumanizing stigma attached to this diagnosis
cues.en: And yet, the dehumanizing stigma attached to this diagnosis
cues.zh: 然而，由於精神病的診斷 會讓人背上沒人性的汙名，

cues.text: can prevent people from seeking help.
cues.en: can prevent people from seeking help.
cues.zh: 然而，由於精神病的診斷 會讓人背上沒人性的汙名， 人們會因此而選擇不去求助。 一般認為思覺失調症患者很危險，

cues.text: People with schizophrenia are often perceived as dangerous,
cues.en: People with schizophrenia are often perceived as dangerous,
cues.zh: 一般認為思覺失調症患者很危險， 但實際上，他們更有可能是 暴力的受害者

cues.text: but are actually much more likely to be the victims of violence
cues.en: but are actually much more likely to be the victims of violence
cues.zh: 但實際上，他們更有可能是 暴力的受害者 而並非加害者。

cues.text: than the perpetrators.
cues.en: than the perpetrators.
cues.zh: 而並非加害者。 適當的治療能協助降低

cues.text: And proper treatment may help reduce the likelihood of violence associated with schizophrenia.
cues.en: And proper treatment may help reduce the likelihood of violence associated with schizophrenia.
cues.zh: 適當的治療能協助降低 思覺失調症相關暴力 發生的可能性。

cues.text: That’s why education— for patients, their families, and their communities—
cues.en: That’s why education— for patients, their families, and their communities—
cues.zh: 那就是為什麼教育——對病人、 其家屬、其社群的教育——

cues.text: helps erode the stigma and improves access to treatment.
cues.en: helps erode the stigma and improves access to treatment.
cues.zh: 那就是為什麼教育——對病人、 其家屬、其社群的教育—— 能協助消除汙名， 並讓更多人得到治療。
